about: Sosnová, Češka (id sosnova): the circuit by Sosnová near Česká Lípa, its 1.7 km combined layout (the outer loop with the two inner parts), one clockwise lap (docs/nove-proge-1-0.md A3, docs/proge/sosnova.md). The route: OSM ways 30857652 (highway=raceway, the outer loop) and 30857653 (the inner parts), from the start line at the end of the bottom straight, every waypoint an OSM node of them.
